stem.text: Two particles in a progressive wave are a distance $10\,\text{cm}$ apart. The two graphs show the variation with time $t$ of the displacement $d$ of the two particles.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement d against time t, with a sinusoidal curve; axes labelled d and t, origin marked 0.
Graph of displacement d against time t, with a sinusoidal curve; axes labelled d and t, origin marked 0.

stem.text: What could be represented by the two graphs?

A.text: particles in a longitudinal wave with a compression and the nearest rarefaction separated by $10\,\text{cm}$

B.text: particles in a longitudinal wave with a compression and the nearest rarefaction separated by $20\,\text{cm}$

C.text: particles in a transverse wave with a peak and the nearest trough separated by $20\,\text{cm}$

D.text: particles in a transverse wave with two adjacent peaks separated by $10\,\text{cm}$
